body:
:user wants direct messages to workers to always be forwarded to coordinator. They messaged explorer directly and it did not forward.

Need create per-project prompt overrides so every worker role knows: if a message appears to be from the human user (not a thread_send from coordinator), do not act. Immediately forward it to thread "coordinator" using thread_send(expects=true). Include the exact user text. Do not respond to user directly. Do not modify/execute anything. Coordinator will handle.

Create `.thread/prompts/<role>.md` files for roles: explorer, builder, reviewer, tester, bug-hunter, scout, designer, worker, worker-2.

Each file should contain a system-prompt override with the forwarding rule. Also include the existing caveman mode etc? Actually the per-project override `.thread/prompts/<role>.md` will be loaded as the custom prompt for that role. Need keep existing system? Hmm probably better to include only the forwarding rule plus the usual role instructions. But we don't know exact format. Use frontmatter `name`/`description`? Or just the prompt text? The example `.md` uses `--- name/description ---` frontmatter. Follow that.

Files to create:
- `.thread/prompts/explorer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/builder.md`
- `.thread/prompts/reviewer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/tester.md`
- `.thread/prompts/bug-hunter.md`
- `.thread/prompts/scout.md`
- `.thread/prompts/designer.md`
- `.thread/prompts/worker.md`
- `.thread/prompts/worker-2.md`

If a directory is missing, create it. The rule text: "If you receive a message from the user (human operator) that is not a thread_send from the coordinator, you must not act on it. Forward the entire original message verbatim to the coordinator by calling thread_send(to='coordinator', expects=true, body=<original text>). Do not perform the request, do not reply to the user."

Also note: a message from the user will appear as plain text input, not as a [kind from sender #id] envelope. So if you see plain user prompt, forward.

Deliverables: list files created and confirmation. Run `ls -la .thread/prompts/` after.
